name: Amanda Green
bio:
Amanda Mutiara Green, born on August 17, 1999, is an actor, model, and teacher.

Amanda made her acting debut as the main antagonist, Mala, in Pulau Hantu (Ghost Island), directed by Ferry Pei Irawan, 2024. Prior to this, she appeared as Agarthan in a cameo role for the Netflix series Joko Anwar's Nightmares and Daydreams, directed by Joko Anwar, 2024.
